title: NICE Stock Analysis: Buy or Sell?
creator: Parkevtate Vosianc CFA
source_note: Detailed summary generated from video captions (manual English captions)
summary: Parkevtate Vosianc analyzes NICE (customer-experience software), which tripled revenue from $1B to over $3B in a decade via land-and-expand, with AI bookings and backlog growing. Revenue growth is accelerating: 7.7% (2025) → 8.3% → 9% → 11.8% (2028), and Wall Street is more optimistic than management's $3.5B 2028 guide. But margins are the red flag: cash flow from operations-to-sales slipped from over 20% back to 20%, and ROIC fell from ~15% to 10.8%, below his WACC estimate — he wants at least margin stabilization alongside the growth. Valuation looks cheap: forward P/E below the expected growth rate. His DCF (modest growth assumptions: FCF dips to $600M in 2026, then rises to $990M by 2030) yields a $188 fair value versus $116 market — ~62% upside. Call: NICE BUY but with low conviction until margins stabilize or inflect; he'll keep monitoring. First tracked call on NICE; no flip.
